tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm paper in light, near-black in dark. The default ground for every section.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Browser frames, cards on hover, inputs, the open mobile menu.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the area behind a product visual, the concept status, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section rules, card and frame outlines, table rows. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button, inputs, lang switch). ≥3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, accent-soft (≥14:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: taglines, leads, metadata values. On every surface (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: index numbers, captions, URL in a browser frame. On surface and surface-raised only (4.9:1 light) — not on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lab vermilion. Primary CTA fill, the slash in the wordmark, section index numbers, the featured marker. As text only on surface / surface-raised (4.5:1 light). At most one accent-filled control per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill (primary button). Never hard-code white: in dark the accent is light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-ink text: highlighted table row in a skeleton, featured ribbon.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text on accent-soft (5.7:1).

tokens.name: blueprint
tokens.usage: Technical blue: inline links, diagrams and architecture lines, the in-development status, the focus ring. Text on every surface (≥6:1).

tokens.name: blueprint-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for blueprint text: in-development badge, diagram nodes, calendar blocks in skeletons.

tokens.name: status-prototype
tokens.usage: Prototype status text and dot, on surface or status-prototype-soft.

tokens.name: status-prototype-soft
tokens.usage: Prototype badge ground.

tokens.name: status-demo
tokens.usage: Live-demo status text and dot, on surface or status-demo-soft.

tokens.name: status-demo-soft
tokens.usage: Live-demo badge ground.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Live status text and dot, on surface or status-live-soft. Always paired with the word — never color alone.

tokens.name: status-live-soft
tokens.usage: Live badge ground.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The one inverted band per page: Contact. Also the footer.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface (16:1). Also the focus ring on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse-surface (≥6:1).

tokens.name: inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Accent on inverse-surface: the primary button fill and the email underline in the Contact band. As text only at 24px+ (4.5:1 dark theme).

tokens.name: on-inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an inverse-accent fill (≥5.2:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in prose — an alias of blueprint.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid, 2px offset, on surface / surface-raised / surface-sunken. On inverse-surface use inverse-ink.
